decisionsTitle: The public list shows only the club's own members' club: the typed clubs hidden by default
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13**, with the race live and the public list in front of him: «people type stupid things there, I just want to show Brașov Runners members and ignore the other clubs … but I still want to show the BVR ones». The club column of «Cine vine» was whatever the person typed (§85, §143, §396 name it a display of what they wrote); on a live race that is a free-text field on a public page.

**1. The setting.** Migration `0145_public_list_club` (expand only, generated by drizzle-kit): an enum `public_list_club` (`members_only`, `as_typed`, `hidden`) and one column `events.public_list_club`, `NOT NULL DEFAULT 'members_only'`, no backfill — every event that exists, and every one created, shows less than before the moment it ships. In the editor, in «Lista publică a participanților» under the list's switches, **«Clubul pe lista publică»**: three native radios, **«Doar {club}»** (the default), **«Cum l-au scris»** and **«Nu arăta clubul»**, with a one-sentence help (the club's name from the platform's constant, §357). Saved through the editor's save service with the other switches (a form without the box leaves the stored mode, a value that is no mode is refused), audited as `event.public_list_club_changed` with from and to on every date a save changed it, carried by a series, a duplicate and the repeats, and the public cache expired on the save.

**2. «Doar» the club's name — the rule.** The cell holds the club's own name (`CLUB_NAME`) only when **both** hold: (a) the registration's person is on the club's members list — the same test the member bibs and the list's «Membru (verificat)» use (`memberCanonicalEmails`: a live account on «Echipa», any role, compared through the canonicalizer, never a raw address) — and (b) the typed club names the club, by one tested function (`namesTheClub`): case, diacritics, punctuation, spaces and filler words («Clubul», «Asociația», «Team») folded; the spellings derived from the configured name (the words in order, the last one singular too, the initials with the first word either way round: «BR Brașov»), plus the club's usual nicknames («BVR», «BV Runners»); the whole folded cell must be one of them — never a substring of another name («Brașov Runners Cluj» is another club, «Runners» alone is nobody's, a bare «BR» names any club). Every other cell is blank, and the column — header included — is not drawn when no row on the page holds a value. The query selects the typed text only for a member (`case when` in the SQL), so a non-member's text does not even leave the database. It applies to every row the list draws: confirmed, pending, waiting, the special guests when shown. A new or removed account expires the cached lists, because membership is part of what the page says.

**3. The other two modes.** «Cum l-au scris» is the list as it was, column included even when empty. «Nu arăta clubul» draws no column and selects nothing. The backoffice, the CSV and Excel exports, the desk and the bibs keep the typed club unchanged — this is a display setting of the public list. The event's JSON file carries it as `publicList.club` (a file made before it existed imports with the default), and the diff names it.

**Refused:**

- **Showing a member's membership regardless of what they typed.** A member who typed nothing, or another club, shows nothing: they did not claim the club on the form, and the privacy notice describes the club as the one they wrote. Showing membership anyway would be a new disclosure (`AGENTS.md` §10.10); if the owner asks, it is a later follow-up behind a notice placeholder.
- **Keeping the free text as the default.** A public list is a disclosure; the safe side is the default, and the club can open it per event.
- **A substring or fuzzy match.** «Brașov Runners Cluj» must not read as the club; only the whole cell, folded, counts.
- **A hardcoded name.** The spellings come from the platform's one constant; only the nicknames no rule can derive («BVR») are written down.

Amends §32, §143 and §396 (what the public list shows) and §85 (the club field is still asked and kept as typed).
changelogLine: - **The public list shows only the club's own club** — the new «Clubul pe lista publică» of each event is «Doar Brașov Runners» by default: the «Club» column shows the club's name for a member who typed it (BVR, the full name, any usual spelling) and nothing else, and is not drawn when empty; «Cum l-au scris» keeps today's list, «Nu arăta clubul» removes the column. The backoffice and the exports keep what was typed. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Each event has a «Clubul pe lista publică» (`events.public_list_club`: `members_only` by default for every event that exists and every one created, `as_typed`, `hidden`), saved through the editor's save service with a form that carries it, left as stored by one that does not, refused when it is no mode, audited as `event.public_list_club_changed` with from and to, carried by a series, a copy and the event's JSON file (`publicList.club`; a file without it imports with the default), and the public cache is expired on the save (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Under `members_only` the public list's club cell holds the club's own name only for a registration whose person is on the club's members list (the member bibs' own test) AND whose typed club names the club — case, diacritics, punctuation, spaces and filler words folded, the club's name and its usual short forms (BVR, «BR Brașov», «Brașov Runners Club»…), never a substring of another name; a member who typed another club or nothing, and a non-member who typed the club's name, show a blank cell, and the typed text of a non-member is not even selected (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The «Club» column of the public list is not drawn under `members_only` when no row on the page holds a value, is drawn as it always was under `as_typed`, and is never drawn under `hidden`; the setting applies to the confirmed, pending and waiting rows alike, and leaves the backoffice, the exports, the desk and the bibs on the typed club (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
Adding or removing a member account expires the cached public lists (`places`), so a person who is no longer a member stops showing the club's name at once (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the public list shows only the club's own members' club
